prompts.heroV3Prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL high-detail editorial family photograph in a real-looking middle-income apartment kitchen. Native4K requested, 26:15 landscape delivery2600x1500. Input1 is an ACTUAL Brooklyn apartment kitchen architectural reference: study its real appliance wall, sink peninsula, working-side aisle and nearby dining table. Use these physical relationships to construct a different family-sized apartment; do not copy its art/clock/decor. Input2 is photographic inspiration for natural faces, skin, hands and close family interaction; do not copy identities or exact pose. No text, icons, logos or symbols anywhere.
Compose a medium-wide eye-level35mm photo from dining side of a modest peninsula, family in RIGHT60%, left40% naturally quiet continuation of room/counter/cabinetry for website copy, no gradient and no blank artificial wall. Sink peninsula at right foreground with brushed steel main tap and a slender separate filtered drinking-water tap; real sink bowl, believable tap mounting and sink/counter depth. Kitchen working aisle BEHIND peninsula, with wall oven/stove/hood and fridge further back, white modest cabinets and wooden accents. Window daylight from right. Keep appliances realistically proportioned, no two counters merging, no person trapped behind wall-backed sink. Do not expose a filter unit: the system is properly concealed inside cabinet; foreground filtration cue is the separate drinking tap and fresh clear water in glass. No product cutout, no giant equipment on counter.
Exactly FIVE family members with distinct readable faces and plausible age differences: mother37 on WORKING side of peninsula holding a partly filled glass at chest level after using drinking tap, looking gently toward daughter; father40 beside her at right, securely holding baby boy9months on hip, forearm supporting bottom and other hand supporting back, baby in plain cream romper looks toward mother. Older son14 sits on dining side at far right, leaning naturally on counter and holding a glass with believable grip; younger daughter7 stands beside him, hand on countertop, listening to mother. All five faces visible and fully in frame, no identical smiles, quiet candid familial ease, father slight smile, son neutral attentive expression, mother speaking softly. Family occupies enough frame for lifelike eyes, fine facial hair, natural teeth, pores, skin folds and subtly imperfect hair. Clothing ordinary cotton, realistic folds, varied natural colours without matching coordinated uniform.
Use reference2's photographic detail and natural humanity; avoid glossy AI models. Clean but genuinely used nice apartment: discreet kettle and wooden chopping board by back wall, bowl with real red apples, one folded tea towel. No extravagant marble, no grime, no excessive clutter. Bright neutral daylight with natural falloff, actual material colours, no colour grading or orange cast, controlled reflections in glass and stainless steel. Moderate depth of field, background architecture still clear. Single coherent photograph, not advertising composite.
